scripts.build: bun run --filter bio-mcp-unified build && bun run --filter burp-web build
scripts.dev: bun run --filter bio-mcp-unified build && concurrently -n mcp,backend,frontend -c cyan,green,blue "bun run --filter bio-mcp-unified dev" "bun run --filter burp dev" "bun run --filter burp-web dev"
scripts.test: bun run --filter bio-mcp-unified test && bun run --filter burp test
